description: Creates a Global FinReg account for a user from their email address, so they can order and manage LEIs. GFR emails the address a link to set a password; you get no access to the account from this tool. After the user has set a password, register for access with /auth.md and use the account tools. If the address already has an account nothing changes, and the answer is the same. Ask the user for their email address, first name and last name, and confirm them with them before calling.

currencyCode.description: Currency for prices and invoices, e.g. EUR, DKK, SEK, NOK, USD, GBP. Default EUR.

email.description: The user's email address. The account and all GFR emails use it.

firstName.description: The user's first name, as the user gave it. Required.

languageCode.description: Language code for the account, e.g. en, da, nn (Norwegian), sv, de, fr. The welcome email is in en, da, nn or sv, otherwise English. Default en.

lastName.description: The user's last name, as the user gave it. Required.

name: create_user
title: Create a Global FinReg account
